title: Smart gateway implementation mapping
summary: One registry and Smart gateway facade for inline and block components used by all 32 Russian component routes.
current_behavior: SmartComponentGateway resolves every Smart definition through provider ownership and contains no namespace or component-ID dispatch.
Framework manifests, props and assets are lock validated.
SmartRenderer consumes one normalized invocation/context and registered adapter/strategy IDs; it contains no component-ID list.
ProjectSmartProvider compiles a fixed smart/ root under one declared namespace; project.notice proves the typed IR and asset path without engine registration.
Every public Framework dotted directive compiles to SmartComponentNode and resolves through the same provider-owned Gateway; the old Framework extract/hydrate renderer path is deleted.
M2 resolves badge to docara.badge through ComponentAliasRegistry and routes all 16 calls through DocumentRendererRegistry and the content mode of the same SmartComponentGateway facade.
The structural component definition and template return HTML, diagnostics and provenance without owning public documentation prose.
M3.2 routes every authored Alert block through DocumentRendererRegistry and SmartComponentGateway::renderComponentBlock using one manifest/template contract.
The compatibility Markdown Alert renderer delegates to that same gateway and no longer assembles a second Alert HTML artifact.
M5.4 replaces the separate inline/block gateway methods with one renderComponentContract entrypoint over the shared ComponentContractNode interface.
known_deviations: The accepted Russian component pages use generic component_block, typed_directive and inline component contracts rather than route-specific parser branches.
The bounded LegacyBundledSmartProvider adapts the six pre-portable repository layouts into the pinned v1 contract; new project/package artifacts use the portable filesystem layout directly.

Exact SF5 pin d6f90bba resolves view data and then overwrites that record with a string before renderTemplate; Smart::render also treats slot as a prop. Full cross-host normalized context is blocked pending a new exact Framework revision or explicit contract decision.
RegionCompositionResolver keeps the Goal 2-owned shell region allowlist; Goal 1 does not claim Design Registry completion.
deletion_gates: Retire InlineComponentRenderer::badge only after all badge calls reach one component node/gateway and exact HTML/assets parity passes.
Remove LegacyBundledSmartProvider only after bundled artifact directories are physically normalized with exact public parity.
